content: Human-labeling session — navigation-confined-hard-only:hard seed 1. Objective: Confined-aisle map: three vertical ore silo walls split the area into four lanes, each wall with one 6-cell gap that alternates top/bottom/top — the only path is a serpentine detour. Your spawn row is NORTH or SOUTH by seed. March every unit into the SE egress zone near (55,30) with zero losses, within about 30 turns. Bashing silos wastes the budget.
